# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Only write down the names and addresses of co-workers and witnesses of the incident on the Form A (the \"Incident Supplemental Form\").
3. After recording all the pertinent information, fill in the relevant part of the Form B that appears on the following page(s).
4. Finish filling in the information requested on Form A.
5. See the back of this document for information on how to return the completed forms.
6. Be brief when describing the incident and keep the focus on how the injury occurred. Do not give sensitive information about the victim, witnesses, or others that is not specifically related to the incident itself.

For more information about this form please visit.
